issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְתַלְמַי' is a personal name 'Talmai', but the Chinese renders it as '他瑪人' (people of Tamar), which is a mistranslation of the name.

The Hebrew 'נִבְנְתָה לִפְנֵי צֹעַן מִצְרָיִם' means 'was built before Zoan of Egypt' (i.e., built seven years before Zoan), but the Chinese '是早於埃及的索安七年的面而建造的' is garbled and unclear, adding '面' (face/surface) and misrepresenting the meaning as 'built before the face of seven years of Zoan of Egypt'.
